trace_handoff.statement: The same uninterrupted trace stores descriptor field C35BD0, publishes C35BD2, transforms C35BDE, loads C35BD2 into A5 at the C35BF0 walker, and then emits two C35BD4 line segments.

qualification: The placement tuple, descriptor/control stream, immutable local triples, two-edge topology, and two following line submissions are observed in one trace. This does not identify the polyline as a road, coastline, building, city, or landmark, and does not establish static global vertex coordinates.
